plan.title: bug(issue_ingest): backtick-delimited inline code stripped from items[].title

narratives.Description: Fix `task issue:ingest` so acceptance-criteria list items preserve backtick-delimited inline code in `plan.items[].title`. The Overview narrative already round-trips correctly; only the items[] extraction path strips code spans via overly aggressive preprocessing.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Edit `packages/core/src/intake/markdown-scanners.ts` (and `packages/core/src/intake/issue-ingest.ts` if the title path delegates there) so AC list-item parsing preserves inline code spans — do not run full `stripCodeBlocks` on text used for `plan.items[].title`.
2. Add regression tests in `packages/core/src/intake/markdown-scanners.test.ts` and `packages/core/src/intake/issue-ingest.test.ts` with #1269/#1270 fixture bodies asserting expected titles.
3. Run `pnpm -w exec vitest run packages/core/src/intake/markdown-scanners.test.ts packages/core/src/intake/issue-ingest.test.ts` as verification evidence; add CHANGELOG entry.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer ingesting GitHub issues, I want acceptance-criteria item titles to preserve inline code references, so that structured vBRIEF items remain actionable without manual repair.
narratives.Overview:
## Why

`scripts/issue_ingest.py` strips backtick-delimited inline code from the GitHub issue body when populating `plan.items[].title`. The narrative fields (`plan.narratives.Overview`) preserve backticks correctly — only the `items[]` parser is affected.

See issue #1276 for full reproduction (#1269, #1270, PR #1271).

narrative.Acceptance: Given an issue body with backtick-delimited inline code in acceptance criteria, when `task issue:ingest` runs, then `plan.items[].title` retains the semantic code content (not garbled fragments like "passes" or empty parens).
Given fixture issue bodies mirroring #1269 and #1270 acceptance criteria, when unit tests run, then parsed item titles match expected non-garbled strings.
Given the fix lands, when `task check` runs on the PR branch, then it exits 0.

expected_outputs: Inline code preserved in ingested items[].title
Regression tests for backtick AC lines
